jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day To ensure business continuity and maintain high operational standards, the Duisburg Training Center within Siemens Energy's Compression division requires a TCP Product Trainer to deliver technical training on compression products. This role is critical for maintaining the technical expertise of field service technicians and customer support operations globally. To address these business aims, this role focuses on technical training delivery for installation and maintenance activities for all kind of Siemens Energy compressors. Your workplace is the state-of-the-art product training center in Duisburg – where various training modules are available. This structure ensures that training programs are up-to-date, aligned with product engineering standards, and delivered safely and effectively. The German Diabetes Center (DDZ) is the Leibniz Institute for Diabetes Research at Heinrich Heine University Düsseldorf. The DDZ is an interdisciplinary research center linking molecular and cell biological basic with clinical and epidemiological research approaches. The DDZ has the aim to develop new approaches for prevention, early detection and diagnosis of diabetes mellitus and to improve therapy and treatment of its complications.The Institute for Clinical Diabetology (Director: Prof. Dr. Michael Roden) is looking for anEpidemiologist (postdoc - m/f/d) We are searching for a candidate with (1) a doctoral degree in epidemiology, (bio)statistics or a comparable discipline, (2) the ability to work in an interdisciplinary manner with physicians and life scientists, and (3) knowledge of epidemiological methodology and statistical analysis systems (e.g. SAS or R). In addition, excellent writing and communication skills in English are required. Experience in the analysis of proteomics data would be desirable.The project will be a collaboration between the research group Inflammation (Prof. Dr. Christian Herder) and the Clinical Study Center (Prof. Dr. Robert Wagner, PD Dr. Oana-Patricia Zaharia) at DDZ. Tasks include planning epidemiological analyses within different cohort studies, performing statistical analyses in projects related to the link between inflammation, diabetes and cardiovascular complications, and communicating results in conferences and publications. The coordination of projects with internal and external partners is important as the position will be linked to projects with the Department of Cardiology, Pulmonology and Vascular Medicine at the Medical Faculty, Heinrich Heine University Düsseldorf.An exciting and diversified fulltime job in a multidisciplinary team. The project should start on the earliest possible start date with a 3-year-contract.A salary as based on qualification and experience according to TV-L in its current version for North Rhine-Westphalia.Family-friendly working conditions and equal gender policy. Since May 2011, the DDZ is a “Career and Family” audit-acknowledged center.Women are especially encouraged to apply, and in the case of equal qualification will be given preference. Similarly, persons with disabilities will be given preference.
